issue.body: ### Security advisory Fixes CVE-2026-64849 (GHSA-7gwp-5pfp-969j). ### Related Issues/PRs Closes #24179 ### What changes are proposed in this pull request? Fixes a DNS-rebinding SSRF bypass in outbound webhook delivery (reported in #24179). `_validate_webhook_url` resolves the webhook hostname via `socket.getaddrinfo` and checks that every resolved IP is public (`ip.is_global`), but it **discards the resolved IP**. The subsequent `session.post(webhook.url)` then **re-resolves the hostname independently**. This is a TOCTOU gap: a DNS-rebinding attacker can return a public IP at validation time (passing the check) and a private/link-local IP (e.g. `169.254.169.254`, `127.0.0.1`) at request time, reaching cloud instance-metadata endpoints or internal services. This PR closes the gap by validating the peer IP of the **actual connected socket**, immediately after `connect()` returns and before any TLS handshake or HTTP data is exchanged. Because there is no second DNS resolution between the check and the request, rebinding has nothing to exploit. Key design points: - A new `SSRFProtectedHTTPAdapter` (in `mlflow/webhooks/ssrf.py`) installs urllib3 connection classes that call `sock.getpeername()` right after the TCP connect and reject non-public IPs. It is scoped **only** to the webhook delivery session, so urllib3 behavior is never altered process-wide. - Works for both HTTP and HTTPS. For HTTPS, `_new_conn` returns the raw TCP socket before the TLS handshake, so the IP check runs pre-TLS. TLS still runs against the original hostname, so **certificate validation is unaffected** (unlike pinning the URL to a resolved IP, which the issue correctly notes breaks HTTPS). - The check raises `SSRFProtectionError` (not a urllib3 exception type), so it is **not retried** and the delivery fails closed on the first attempt. - The existing `MLFLOW_WEBHOOK_ALLOW_PRIVATE_IPS` escape hatch is honored at connect time for local development. `_validate_webhook_url` is retained as defense-in-depth (it still rejects obviously-private URLs at creation and provides a clear error), but it is no longer the sole protection. ### How is this PR tested? - [x] Existing unit/integration tests - [x] New unit/integration tests - [ ] Manual tests New tests in `tests/webhooks/test_ssrf.py`: - The webhook session uses the SSRF-protected adapter for both schemes. - A simulated DNS-rebinding attack (hostname resolves to loopback at connect time via a patched `getaddrinfo`) is blocked with `SSRFProtectionError` — this is the core regression test for the reported vulnerability. - Direct private-IP connections are blocked by default. - Private IPs are allowed when `MLFLOW_WEBHOOK_ALLOW_PRIVATE_IPS=true`. - The SSRF error is raised once per connection (not retried). All existing `tests/webhooks/test_delivery.py` and `tests/utils/test_validation.py` tests pass. ### Does this PR require documentation update? - [x] No. ### Does this PR require updating the [MLflow Skills](https://github.com/mlflow/skills) repository? - [x] No. ### Release Notes #### Is this a user-facing change? - [x] Yes. Webhook delivery now validates the connected peer IP at connection time, closing a DNS-rebinding SSRF bypass that could reach private/internal or cloud-metadata endpoints. #### What component(s), interfaces, languages, and integrations does this PR affect? Components - [x] `area/model-registry`: Model Registry service, APIs, and the fluent client calls for Model Registry #### How should the PR be classified in the release notes? Choose one: - [x] `rn/bug-fix` - A user-facing bug fix worth mentioning in the release notes #### Is this PR a critical bugfix or security fix that should go into the next patch release? - [x] This PR is critical and needs to be in the next patch release

body:
Thanks @AUTHENSOR, excellent report. You pinpointed the exact TOCTOU gap (validation resolves and discards the IP, the request re-resolves independently), traced it through the code, and pre-empted the dead-ends (IP-pinning breaks TLS, DNS caching doesn't save you). The suggested socket-level fix was the right call and is essentially what we shipped.

**Fixed in #24258** (ships in the next patch release).

The fix validates the peer IP of the actual connected socket (`getpeername()`) right after TCP connect, before any TLS handshake or HTTP data. No second DNS resolution between check and request, so the rebinding gap is closed, and TLS still runs against the original hostname so certificate validation is unaffected. It's scoped to the webhook session only, fails closed, and honors `MLFLOW_WEBHOOK_ALLOW_PRIVATE_IPS`. Review added two extras: the proxy path is covered too, and `getpeername()` failures fail closed.

One note on impact for readers: the default `MLFLOW_WEBHOOK_ALLOWED_SCHEMES` is `https` only, and cloud metadata endpoints speak plain HTTP, so the IAM-credential path requires an operator to have added `http` to the allowed schemes. Under defaults it's still a real SSRF-connect primitive, which is why we fixed it for the patch release.
Hello! I reported this vulnerability three weeks ago in GHSA-7gwp-5pfp-969j. I was wondering why this week-old report is considered the first?

Thanks @freeman-bb, fair point, you reported it first via the GHSA. We found this independently through code review (the GHSA wasn't visible when we filed this issue), but you absolutely have priority on the discovery. Glad to see it's fixed in #24258 either way.

Hi @freeman-bb, you're right, and thanks for flagging this. You reported this first via GHSA-7gwp-5pfp-969j on June 12; #24179 was an independent code-review find two weeks later that unfortunately drove the public fix before we'd processed your advisory. That's on us. Discovery priority is yours. The advisory will be published crediting you as the original reporter, with @AUTHENSOR as an independent co-discoverer. Apologies for the delay and the confusion.

issue.body:
# 🛡️ MLflow: 웹훅 전달 시 인증되지 않은 전체 읽기 SSRF (HTTP 리다이렉트 및 DNS 리바인딩을 통한 우회) > **탐지 일시:** 2026-08-18 06:47:59 (KST) > **탐지 사유:** 🆕 신규 Critical 취약점 > **⚡ 대응 우선순위: 🟠 높음** — CVSS Critical (악용 신호는 아직 미확인) ![CVSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CVSS-9.3-FF0000) ![EPSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/EPSS-0.00%25-blue) ![KEV](https://img.shields.io/badge/KEV-No-CCCCCC) EPSS 0.00% — 향후 30일 내 실제 악용 시도 확률 (출처: FIRST.org) **취약점 유형 (CWE):** CWE-918 ## 📄 취약점 개요 검증되지 않은 HTTP 리다이렉트로 인해 _validate_webhook_url 검증을 우회하여 내부 서비스나 클라우드 메타데이터 서비스에 접근할 수 있습니다.
원문 (English) > MLflow is an open source AI engineering platform for agents, large language models, and machine learning models. Prior to 3.15.0, the unauthenticated POST /api/2.0/mlflow/webhooks/{id}/test endpoint calls _validate_webhook_url() in mlflow/utils/validation.py only for the original URL while mlflow/webhooks/delivery.py follows redirects and re-resolves the hostname without pinning the validated address, allowing attackers to reach internal or cloud metadata services and receive response_status and response_body. This issue is fixed in version 3.15.0.
## 📦 영향 받는 자산 (벤더 / 제품 / 버전) | 벤더 | 제품 | 버전 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | mlflow | mlflow | < 3.15.0 (단일 버전) | ## 🔍 AI 심층 분석 ### 기술적 근본 원인 MLflow의 unauthenticated POST /api/2.0/mlflow/webhooks/{id}/test 엔드포인트가 원본 URL에 대해서만 mlflow/utils/validation.py의 _validate_webhook_url()을 호출하고, 이후 리다이렉트를 따르거나 호스트명을 재해석할 때 검증된 주소를 고정(pinning)하지 않아 발생하는 CWE-918 (Server-Side Request Forgery, SSRF) 취약점이다. ### 🎯 공격 벡터 상세 | 항목 | 내용 | | :--- | :--- | | **공식 벡터** | `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:L/A:N` | | **상세 해석** | • CVSS:3.1
• 공격 경로: 네트워크 (Network)
• 복잡성: 낮음
• 필요 권한: 없음
• 사용자 관여: 없음
• 범위: 변경됨 (Changed)
• 기밀성: 높음
• 무결성: 낮음
• 가용성: 없음 | ### 🏹 공격 시나리오 (MITRE ATT&CK) MITRE ATT&CK 기반 공격 흐름: **초기 접근(Initial Access)** – 공격자는 네트워크를 통해 인증 없이 취약한 엔드포인트에 접근하여 웹훅 테스트 요청을 보낸다 (T1190: Exploit Public-Facing Application). **실행(Execution)** – MLflow가 리다이렉트를 따르며 호스트명을 재해석하는 과정에서 검증된 주소가 고정되지 않아, 내부 네트워크 또는 클라우드 메타데이터 서비스로 요청이 전달된다 (T1210: Exploitation of Remote Services). [추정] **영향(Impact)** – 공격자가 내부 서비스에 도달하여 response_status와 response_body를 수신함으로써 내부 시스템 정보나 클라우드 메타데이터를 획득한다 (T1595: Active Scanning). [추정] ### 💥 비즈니스 영향 인증 없는 공격자가 서버 측 요청 위조(SSRF)를 통해 내부 시스템 또는 클라우드 메타데이터 서비스에 접근하여 응답 데이터를 수신할 수 있으며, 이로 인해 민감한 내부 정보 유출 및 인프라 구조 노출 등의 비즈니스적 보안 위협이 발생할 수 있다. [추정] ## 🛡️ 권고 대응 방안 - mlflow를 버전 3.15.0 이상으로 업데이트 - 제조사(MLflow)의 공식 보안 권고 및 패치 적용 - https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/security/advisories/GHSA-7gwp-5pfp-969j 참고 ## 🔗 참고 자료 - https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/security/advisories/GHSA-7gwp-5pfp-969j - https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/issues/24179 - https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/pull/24258 - https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/commit/ba949522477cbd5915aa55d29b0cfad7d5ddf939 - https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/releases/tag/v3.15.0 --- 📊 **데이터 출처**: CVE(cvelistV5, CC0) · NVD(NIST, 공공) · CISA KEV·SSVC/vulnrichment(공공/CC0) · EPSS([FIRST.org](https://www.first.org/epss/)) · [OSV.dev](https://osv.dev)(CC-BY 4.0) · GitHub Advisory · Metasploit(Rapid7, BSD-3) · PoC/ExploitDB(원문 미게시·링크만). 공개 탐지 룰은 각 출처·라이선스 고지를 보존합니다. issue.title: [Argus] CVE-2026-64849: MLflow: 웹훅 전달 시 인증되지 않은 전체 읽기 SSRF 취약점
issue.body:
# 🛡️ MLflow: 웹훅 전달 시 인증되지 않은 전체 읽기 SSRF 취약점 > **탐지 일시:** 2026-08-20 02:56:01 (KST) > **탐지 사유:** 🚨 KEV 등재 > **⚡ 대응 우선순위: 🔴 즉시 대응** — CISA KEV 등재 — 실제 악용 확인됨 ![CVSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CVSS-9.3-FF0000) ![EPSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/EPSS-1.11%25-blue) ![KEV](https://img.shields.io/badge/KEV-YES-FF0000) EPSS 1.11% — 향후 30일 내 실제 악용 시도 확률 (출처: FIRST.org) **취약점 유형 (CWE):** CWE-918 ## 🧨 위협 신호 - **CISA SSVC** (vulnrichment, CC0): exploitation=none, automatable=yes, technical_impact=total - **PoC 공개** (출처: nomi-sec/trickest, 원문 미게시·링크만): 2건 — [PoC 링크](https://github.com/codeb0ssx/CVE-2026-64849-PoC) ## 📄 취약점 개요 검증되지 않은 HTTP 리다이렉트 및 DNS rebinding을 통해 내부 서비스나 클라우드 메타데이터에 접근 가능합니다.
원문 (English) > MLflow is an open source AI engineering platform for agents, large language models, and machine learning models. Prior to 3.15.0, the unauthenticated POST /api/2.0/mlflow/webhooks/{id}/test endpoint calls _validate_webhook_url() in mlflow/utils/validation.py only for the original URL while mlflow/webhooks/delivery.py follows redirects and re-resolves the hostname without pinning the validated address, allowing attackers to reach internal or cloud metadata services and receive response_status and response_body. This issue is fixed in version 3.15.0.
## 📦 영향 받는 자산 (벤더 / 제품 / 버전) | 벤더 | 제품 | 버전 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | mlflow | mlflow | < 3.15.0 (단일 버전) | ## 🔍 AI 심층 분석 ### 기술적 근본 원인 MLflow의 인증되지 않은 POST /api/2.0/mlflow/webhooks/{id}/test 엔드포인트에서 원본 URL에 대해서만 _validate_webhook_url()을 호출하며, 이후 mlflow/webhooks/delivery.py가 리다이렉트를 따르고 검증된 주소를 고정(pinning)하지 않고 호스트 명을 다시 해결(re-resolves)하여 발생하는 CWE-918 (Server-Side Request Forgery) 취약점이다. ### 🎯 공격 벡터 상세 | 항목 | 내용 | | :--- | :--- | | **공식 벡터** | `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:L/A:N` | | **상세 해석** | • CVSS:3.1
• 공격 경로: 네트워크 (Network)
• 복잡성: 낮음
• 필요 권한: 없음
• 사용자 관여: 없음
• 범위: 변경됨 (Changed)
• 기밀성: 높음
• 무결성: 낮음
• 가용성: 없음 | ### 🏹 공격 시나리오 (MITRE ATT&CK) MITRE ATT&CK 기반 공격 흐름: **초기 접근(Initial Access)** – 공격자는 인증 없이 취약한 POST /api/2.0/mlflow/webhooks/{id}/test 엔드포인트에 접근하여 요청을 보낸다 (T1190: Exploit Public-Facing Application). **발견(Discovery)** – [추정] 애플리케이션이 리다이렉트를 따르고 호스트 명을 다시 해결하는 과정을 악용하여 내부 네트워크 또는 클라우드 메타데이터 서비스의 존재와 정보를 탐색한다 (T1046: Network Service Discovery). **수집(Collection)** – [추정] SSRF 취약점을 통해 내부 서비스나 클라우드 메타데이터 서비스에 도달하여 응답 상태 및 본문(response_status, response_body)을 탈취한다 (T1530: Data from Cloud Storage Object / T1590: Gather Victim Network Information). ### 💥 비즈니스 영향 공격자가 내부 네트워크 서비스나 클라우드 메타데이터 서비스에 접근하여 민감한 정보(response_body 등)를 획득할 수 있으며, 기밀성(Confidentiality)에 심각한 피해를 줄 수 있고 무결성(Integrity) 일부에 영향을 미칠 수 있다. ## 🛡️ 권고 대응 방안 - 제조사인 MLflow의 버전 3.15.0 이상으로 업데이트 적용 - 공식 보안 자문 및 패치 적용 (참고: https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/security/advisories/GHSA-7gwp-5pfp-969j) ## 🔗 참고 자료 - https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/security/advisories/GHSA-7gwp-5pfp-969j - https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/issues/24179 - https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/pull/24258 - https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/commit/ba949522477cbd5915aa55d29b0cfad7d5ddf939 - https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/releases/tag/v3.15.0 - https://github.com/codeb0ssx/CVE-2026-64849-PoC (PoC, nomi-sec/trickest) - https://github.com/BiuTrap/CVE-2026-64849 (PoC, nomi-sec/trickest) --- 📊 **데이터 출처**: CVE(cvelistV5, CC0) · NVD(NIST, 공공) · CISA KEV·SSVC/vulnrichment(공공/CC0) · EPSS([FIRST.org](https://www.first.org/epss/)) · [OSV.dev](https://osv.dev)(CC-BY 4.0) · GitHub Advisory · Metasploit(Rapid7, BSD-3) · PoC/ExploitDB(원문 미게시·링크만). 공개 탐지 룰은 각 출처·라이선스 고지를 보존합니다. AI 분석·위험도 분류는 **참고용**이며 정확성을 보증하지 않습니다.

This issue is fixed in version 3.15.0.
